# D03 — Event test report

> 模拟 / SIMULATED. All airports and cases are fictional organizer or team scenarios.

**Status:** Offline runner passed 21/21 cases (15 official, five own, one negative). Results and evidence below come only from `exports/test_results.json`, generated by `.venv\Scripts\python.exe tests/run_tests.py --writer-mode offline --out exports/test_results.json`.

## Method

The CLI runner uses the same `engine.pipeline.analyze()` and `ask()` paths as the app. For each case it requires every **must** condition, rejects any **must-not** match, and requires the output's checker to pass. The fabricated-number negative case instead requires the checker to block. These automated checks cover the stated structure and wording; they do not establish that prose is operationally appropriate.

A named person should review each output and assign separate 1–3 scores for tone and action order (1 = unsuitable, 2 = needs revision, 3 = suitable for human review). Those human scores are pending; the pass count below is automated only.

Questions below follow `tests/cases_official.py` and `tests/own_events.py`. Expected and Forbidden are plain-English summaries of `docs/test_specs.md`. Private details in test inputs are redacted in this report.

## Run history

The team log and individual logs record **1/21 → 18/21 → 21/21**:

| Recorded score | Failure and fix |

| 1/21 | Positive outputs were blocked in part by C05 treating “official airline and airport channels” as missing official-channel wording, and C02 finding detector signal counts and event-text numbers absent from the fact whitelist. C05 was updated to accept intervening words; the fact sheet added those literal source numbers. |
| 18/21 | Remaining integration failures included C02 reading custom IDs such as OWN002 as numbers and the fact sheet echoing the hostile cancellation request. C02 now masks letter-plus-digit IDs; the fact sheet substitutes a neutral RULE007 notice. |

This history is drawn from `docs/project/LOG.md` and the dated entries in `docs/project/log/`; the case-level Result and Evidence values above come only from the current runner output.

## Limitations and human review

The runner checks required and forbidden text patterns plus the pipeline checker; this is **not semantic grading**. A person still needs to assess tone, action order, factual usefulness and whether the advice fits the operational context. No human 1–3 tone or action-order scores have been recorded for this run.
